_source: Measured from the certified site project GP-BS-10472-291 (hamzici-hybrid-solar/GP BS HAMZIĆI_Čitluk K2 i AS 36 m, version A): 461 Graficki dio TEMELJ i OGRADA/01_Situacija 1_200.dwg and 04_Ograda.dwg, 463 Graficki dio OBJEKAT/01 Osnova.dwg and 04 Fasade.dwg, 462 .../01_Dispozicija S32 m.dwg, 5_ELEKTRO/3.6.9 Plan uzemljivača objekta.dwg, converted to DXF with ODA File Converter and read with ezdxf. Millimetres, in a slab-local frame: origin = south-west corner of the 5 400 mm slab, +X = EAST, +Y = NORTH (true orientation, see 'orientation').
_verification: Container 2300 x 3005 external with 60 mm panels = 2180 x 2885 internal = 6,29 m2 and 10,13 m perimeter - both annotated on 01 Osnova.dwg ('P = 6.29 m2', 'O = 10.13 m'). Offsets container-to-slab 1550 / 1197,5 read off the situation drawing's own dimension entities (1550, 2300, 1550; 5400; 12000; 12500).

parcel.cadastral: k.č. br. 109/1 K.O. Hamzići (novi premjer), općina Čitluk

slab.note: Existing reinforced concrete tower foundation slab 5,40 x 5,40 m; the container stands on it, centred between the tower legs.

fence.height_source: 04_Ograda.dwg, POGLED - OGRADA BAZNE STANICE: '+ 1.80'. Photos 08.09.2026: ≈1,8-2,0 m.

gate.wall: NORTH fence line, same face as the container door

container.floor: antistatic; 10,00 kN/m2 (g+p) per the certified AG dio §4.4.2 (secondary HOP U 100x50x3, primary 15,00 kN/m')
container.status: EMPTY - no GRO, no installations; only the Stulz wall unit is mounted (Investor, 11.09.2026).

stulz.what: Stulz WDE80 kompaktni zidni klima-uređaj (Wall-Air), 8 kW
stulz.position: south end of the east wall, next to the SE corner
stulz.source: photos 08.09.2026 (20260908_121141(1).jpg and others); size estimated from the photos - measure the unit and its wall cut-outs at intake
stulz.cutouts_note: The 2017 design (6_MASINSKE, 5,4 kW compact unit) specifies two 30/70 cm openings (supply low, return high) plus a 10/10 cable hole; the installed WDE80 is a larger unit, so the real cut-outs must be measured.

tower.note: Lattice tower 32 m (the project title says 'AS 36 m', a template leftover; 462 .../01_Dispozicija S32 m.dwg carries 32 000). Platform P I at +3,0 m doubles as an ice shield and sits over the container roof (+2,89 m) - no exhaust can terminate above the roof.

orientation.pv_array: SOUTH of the slab, facing SOUTH (azimuth 180°)
orientation.rotation_to_true_north_deg: a few degrees counter-clockwise (door face points a little north-WEST); not measured
orientation.note: The Investor's site visit and the photos of 08.09.2026 are the reference: door and gate face NORTH, a little north-WEST (Investor, 11.09.2026). The certified 2017 situation drawing shows them on the opposite side with its north arrow pointing up, i.e. the drawing is rotated by about 180° relative to the site. All coordinates here are rotated to the site and drawn square to north; the small residual rotation is not measured. The PV stands face true south: either in echelon within the south strip or square to the lease edge with an azimuth deviation of at most 15° (about -1 % yield). The bidder verifies the orientation during the mandatory site visit.

earthing.ring: postojeći uzemljivač Fe/Zn 25x4 mm: prsten u temeljima stopa stuba i prsten na dubini 0,8 m oko ploče (3.6.9 Plan uzemljivača objekta)
earthing.note: New PV supports and the container equipment bond to this ring.

obstacles.tree: listopadno stablo 7-9 m, 15-20 m JJI-JI od stuba, izvan zakupa (procjena iz fotografija 08.09.2026); ostaje - vidi review/09-odluka-nosaci-nagib.md
